items/momento-magica-1st-level-spell-439.name: Momento Magica, 1st-level spell
items/momento-magica-1st-level-spell-439.effectSummary: Once per day, this memento restores one 1st-level spell slot the user previously expended that day, making the slot available again as though it had not been used. It has no effect for spellcasters who prepare their spells.
